name: narrow-passage
title: Squeeze through a narrow gap
instruction: One adult walks forward along +Z. About 4 m ahead there is a narrow gap between two tall cabinets: the gap is only 0.40 m wide and 0.6 m deep, narrower than the person's shoulders. The person approaches, gets through the gap without touching either cabinet (turning the body sideways as much as needed), and then continues walking normally along +Z. The person is already walking when the clip starts and is still walking when it ends.
